rows.Synonyms:
• KO 85/1596-03
• Nuage Blanc
• Weisse Wolke
• White Cloud (climber, Kordes 1985)
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 1985).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Mattocks Roses / Notcutts as 'White Cloud'.
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1993 as 'Weisse Wolke'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Strong fragrance. Large, semi-double (9-16 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, rounded bloom form. Occasional repeat later in the season.
